g.text: Wheelbase 178 in CONFIRMED. GAWR front 4,630 lb. GAWR rear 7,275 lb. GVWR 11,000 lb. As-built axle weights UNKNOWN (yellow sticker).
Front axle
GAWR 4,630
Rear axle
GAWR 7,275
178 in
x = field measure, aft
W
For W behind the rear axle by x inches
Rear gain = W × (178 + x) / 178
Front change = − W × x / 178
They sum to W. Maximum W at that x = (7275 − rear axle now) × 178 / (178 + x).
Rear axle now is blank, so no maximum box weight is stated.
Worked rows for W = 233.66 lb (two B4810 at 101.4 plus RV5 at 30.86). 12 in and 24 in are scenarios, not measurements. 37.35 in is the Ford chassis frame end.
x = 0 in rear +233.66 lb front 0
x = 12 in rear +249.41 lb front −15.75 lb ESTIMATE — VERIFY as a position
x = 24 in rear +265.16 lb front −31.50 lb ESTIMATE — VERIFY as a position
x = 37.35 in rear +282.69 lb front −49.03 lb chassis landmark, not a proven fit
Split, one 101.4 lb pack at 24 in and the other pack plus hub on the axle: rear +247.33 lb, front −13.67 lb.
Same split at 37.35 in: rear +254.94 lb, front −21.28 lb.
CCC remaining = sticker CCC − added weight. Sticker CCC is blank.
Partial parts sum, manufacturer panel weight: 779.6 lb before enclosure, desk, Starlink model, cables, tow gear, water, and personal gear.
If the conflicting 29.8 lb panel weight is the true one, that partial sum is 564.5 lb. Water is 8.3 lb/gal extra.
GCWR 13,500 − GVWR 11,000 = 2,500 lb of combined headroom when the coach is at GVWR. Abarth curb weight is about 2,491–2,512 lb. Weigh both.
